name: io.github.Omodaka9375/ugnas-mcp
description: Generic MCP server for UGREEN NAS (UGOS) over SSH — 39 tools with dry-run safety.

environmentVariables.description: Path to the config JSON (default: ~/.ugnas-mcp/config.json). See the README for the schema.
environmentVariables.name: UGNAS_MCP_CONFIG

environmentVariables.description: NAS host, e.g. 192.168.1.50. Overrides the config file.
environmentVariables.name: UGNAS_HOST

environmentVariables.description: SSH username. Overrides the config file.
environmentVariables.name: UGNAS_USER

environmentVariables.description: Path to the SSH private key (alternative to UGNAS_PASSWORD).
environmentVariables.name: UGNAS_KEY_PATH

environmentVariables.description: SSH port. Overrides the config file.
environmentVariables.name: UGNAS_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Base directory for relative tool paths (default /volume1).
environmentVariables.name: UGNAS_DEFAULT_SHARE
